title: Grateful Dead Live at Robert F. Kennedy Stadium on 1973-06-10
lineage: transferred by Matt Smith; MAC tapes > Nak BX300 > Apogee Mini Me > Mini DAC (monitoring/mastering) > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > 24/96 FLACs > Samplitude Pro 7.22 > TLH > CD Tag
source: Source: taped and remastered by Monte Barry; Sony TC 2850SD portable stereo cassette recorder Sony ECM 99 single-point stereo mic is hand-held on mic-stand shaft, with arm raised up FOB center infield, between sbd platform and stage platform;

ai_review.summary: A nicely‑sounding audience recording captures a tight, high‑energy show highlighted by an ecstatic Morning Dew, a marathon Birdsong jam and a fireworks‑capped Playing in the Band.
ai_review.review: The AUD source is praised as one of the better crowd recordings, with Charlie’s transfer delivering clear detail despite the usual ambient noise. Musically the performance is described as “on” and tightly locked, featuring standout moments like Morning Dew, an extended Birdsong jam, and a dramatic Playing in the Band that ended with fireworks; the third set’s Dark Star (and guest‑filled jam) also earned special mention. Overall the show feels vibrant and memorable even if it slightly trails the previous night’s legendary outing.

ai_rating.rationale: Most detailed reviews are highly positive about both the music and the audience recording quality; limited number of substantive reviews keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as one of the nicest‑sounding AUDs, with a clear Charlie transfer; some loss of studio‑like tightness but overall crisp and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds to a fireworks‑capped Playing in the Band; third set features an expansive Dark Star/jam that many felt stole the night, giving the concert a strong arc and sustained high energy.
